verdicts.reason: Summary says the creator shares his project to build his own AI agent similar to Cloud Code in order to learn about AI "harneses" (Go/Anthropic details not mentioned, but main claim is there).
Summary explains the agentic loop as a UI loop calling an AI, "construyendo un contexto y llamando a herramientas para realizar acciones, como editar archivos".
Summary says he adds "múltiples agentes en paralelo, visualizando su estado y permitiendo la creación de subagentes".
Summary never states that agents are just wrappers around LLM calls, that products sell the UI, or that the harness is for learning not production.
Summary mentions additional resources including "un repositorio con ejercicios para practicar el 'harness engineering'", though the website is not named.
